item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ad because Magic Hour refused the request for **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

The planned 8-second, silent 16:9 ad is:
- **0–2s:** Messy task cards — “Too much to do?”
- **2–5.5s:** Cards arrange into Morning, Afternoon, and Evening — “One simple daily plan.”
- **5.5–8s:** Blue-and-white end card — **ClearDay** / “A little less overwhelm.”

Once you add credits, I can retry this version.

args.name: ClearDay — From overwhelm to a simple day

style.prompt: Create an 8-second silent 16:9 motion-graphics ad for ClearDay, a fictional app that turns an overwhelming to-do list into a simple daily plan. Design an original simple demo interface; no supplied assets needed. Calm blue-and-white palette, white background, soft sky-blue cards, navy typography, generous whitespace, flat polished app UI. Fixed straight-on camera, no people, no phone device, no photorealism. Large minimal text readable at 480p. Continuous coherent animation with precise sequence: 0–2 seconds: centered white demo app panel on a pale blue background shows a chaotic pile of overlapping to-do cards with small unchecked boxes. Use only a few short labels such as Email, Groceries, Project, Walk, Call. Large heading above reads 'Too much to do?' Cards gently jostle, suggesting overwhelm without frantic motion. 2–5.5 seconds: the SAME task cards smoothly separate and align into three clean, spacious horizontal groups labeled 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening'. Email and Project in Morning, Groceries and Call in Afternoon, Walk in Evening. All cards settle gently with soft easing. Heading becomes 'One simple daily plan.' This is a conceptual demo screen, clear hierarchy and blue accents, no dense detail. 5.5–8 seconds: interface gracefully fades into a clean white end card with the large perfectly spelled navy wordmark 'ClearDay' centered, with a small simple blue sunrise arc above it. Under ClearDay, display the short tagline 'A little less overwhelm.' Hold this final card steady through the end. No other brands, no app store badges, no exaggerated claims, no sound, no music, no speech. Gentle professional minimalist 2D animation.
